title: Facet-dependent photo-Fenton degradation of p-arsanilic acid and arsenic redistribution on hematite
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00232C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yuhan Guo, Yixuan Song, Shengrui Xu, Zhenli Zhu, Lei Ouyang, Qin Shuai
The photo-degradation of p-ASA on hematite HNC and HNP was investigated. Results demonstrated that the catalytic function of hematite is facet-dependent, governing both the transformation of pollutants and their associated environmental risks.
